posts.title: Be open, defer judgement
posts.description: Sometimes, I am reminded not to be quick to judge because I usually don’t know the whole story, and life is hard, and the world is complicated. Every once in a while I even manage to put this to practice. My most recent reminder came from seeing I’m the mom in that viral Giants clip. posts.title: Geniuses are made, not born
posts.description: William James Sidis was a child prodigy. By 18 months old, he could read The New York Times. He entered Harvard University at the age of 11, and a year later he was holding a lecture on 4-dimensional mathematics to professors.
